array.string:
launchctl setenv XDG_CACHE_HOME /Users/erazemk/.cache launchctl setenv XDG_CONFIG_HOME /Users/erazemk/.config launchctl setenv XDG_DATA_HOME /Users/erazemk/.local/share launchctl setenv PATH "$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
launchctl setenv GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT 1 launchctl setenv GOPATH $XDG_DATA_HOME/go launchctl setenv PATH "$GOPATH/bin:$PATH"
launchctl setenv OPENCODE_ENABLE_PARALLEL true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_FILEWATCHER true launchctl setenv OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS true
